description.value: The study examined the impact of FAAH C385A genetic variation on resting-state fronto-amygdala connectivity and task-related emotional processing, including emotion reactivity and emotion regulation.

value: We hypothesized that A-allele carriers show stronger resting state connectivity between amygdala and the target regions of interest (ROI) examined by Dincheva et al. [ 20 ], that is, dACC and vmPFC.

Furthermore, we hypothesized that stronger fronto-amygdala connectivity in these individuals is associated with decreased emotional reactivity during passively viewing of emotional pictures as well as more successful top-down regulation of negative affect during volitional emotion regulation.
